manufacturing_capability.name: dram64 3um launch
manufacturing_capability.description: 64K DRAM recipe dram64_3um_launch. Qualification and release are separate dated assertions.

qualification_requirements.description: Released capacity/pinout/rails and refresh contract
Retention over temperature and voltage, read/write and disturb tests
Speed bins and all-bank board power/timing qualification
At least two matched steppers and recipe-specific one-down capacity before volume stepper manufacture
Map failures and retest the complete launch device without redundancy repair; repair applies only to separately released repairable revisions.

manufacturing_capability.name: AION 3 µm customer-specific mask-ROM manufacture
manufacturing_capability.description: Mask-ROM product recipe within the silicon-gate NMOS logic family; ROM-specific qualification does not qualify arbitrary logic or CPUs.

qualification_requirements.description: Customer-approved image, organisation, mask revision, package, timing and supply contract.
Repeatable wafer probe, full image verification, packaged test and reliability across independent lots.
Released order-specific masks and acceptance before customer shipments.

manufacturing_capability.name: AION 3 µm SRAM manufacture
manufacturing_capability.description: Small SRAM product-family capability, beginning with a 1 Kbit design and evaluating a separately qualified 4 Kbit extension.

qualification_requirements.description: Release each density, pinout, package and speed grade separately.
Read/write, standby leakage, data-pattern and voltage/temperature margins verified on multiple lots.
Production test coverage, package reliability and recurring cost per accepted chip.

manufacturing_capability.name: AION 3 µm 16 Kbit DRAM manufacture
manufacturing_capability.description: Cambridge recipe for the AION 4116-equivalent; production release precedes the June 1978 Aurelia launch.

qualification_requirements.description: Qualify capacitor, sense amplifiers, retention, disturb patterns and refresh across temperature and voltage.
Release 16-pin package, +12/+5/-5 V supplies, sequencing and measured speed grades against the product contract.
Demonstrate repeatable results across independent wafer lots, packaged final test and reliability screening.

manufacturing_capability.name: AION 3 µm ERAv1 manufacture
manufacturing_capability.description: Processor-specific fabrication, test and packaging capability. Initial release covers the 6 MHz part; 8 MHz requires separate measured qualification.

qualification_requirements.description: Frozen design rules, die and mask revisions, package/pinout, rails and power contract.
Functional vectors, timing across voltage/temperature, reliability and repeatable independent lots.
Record whether 6/8 MHz are speed bins or separate revisions; release only demonstrated grades.
Qualified launch inventory and production capacity before 19 May 1980; no dependence on later DRAM-control or sub-3 µm releases.
